jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Senior UX Researcher

Role Located out of: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

The Overview

At Okta, we’re building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we’re specifically focused on protecting the future of work. We bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere, promising to not only protect the identities of our workforce and users but to ask, “what more can we make possible?”

As a Senior UX Researcher at Okta India, you will join a globally distributed research and design team, shaping customer experiences across the Access Management ecosystem. Your mission is to secure workforce access right from physical device bootup delivering frictionless, phishing resistant, and passwordless authentication across macOS, Windows,Linux, iOS, and Android platforms.

In this role, you will lead end to end research initiatives, translating ambiguous product questions into actionable insights that directly influence long term strategy and near term product decisions across global Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams.

Finer Print

You will join an AI first team of researchers and designers supported by leadership who fosters high autonomy, deep ownership, and a strong culture of craft. As part of Okta’s centralized Design & Research organization in Bengaluru, you will act as a key research anchor, working closely with cross functional partners in both India and the US to define problems, explore solutions, and drive impact.

You will balance functional, foundational research with generative explorations that help frame new security and identity paradigms in an evolving, technical problem space.

What You Will Do

As the dedicated User Researcher for Access Management in India, you will own the UX research strategy along with an opportunity to act as a foundational builder for our regional research operations.

• Own Access Management Research in India: Scope, prioritize, and execute generative and evaluative research and aligning cross border roadmaps with high priority business goals across multiple OS platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).

• Build an Exclusive User Panel: Go beyond standard recruiting by proactively building and managing a dedicated panel of user personas, ensuring a direct pipeline to our most critical users and cultivating deep customer empathy.

• Pioneer AI-Driven Efficiency: Champion the secure use of AI tools to automate operationalise recurring work such as transcript synthesis, feedback classification, and qualitative coding, freeing up time for deep strategic thinking.

• Make Research a "Team Sport": Empower cross functional partners in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own high quality evaluative studies through training frameworks, templates, workflows, etc while mentoring cross function partners to raise the overall research mindset.

• Exercise Methodological Rigor: Flexibly apply mixed methodologies including contextual inquiry, usability testing, surveys, and quantitative analysis suited to fast paced product timelines and complex security domains.

• Drive Global Alignment & Storytelling: Collaborate deeply with EPD teams across time zones, synthesizing complex data into compelling stories and actionable recommendations for executive stakeholders.

What We Are Looking For

• Technical Research Expertise: Demonstrated track record of conducting user research within complex, highly technical B2B, enterprise, security, or developer-facing domains.

• Strategic & Autonomous Thinker: Ability to translate business goals and technical ambiguity into structured research plans independently while managing competing priorities across multiple product streams.

• AI Tooling & Practice: Curiosity and active experience incorporating AI tools into your research workflow (e.g., automated transcript synthesis, qualitative coding, prompt engineering) to accelerate time-to-insight without compromising rigor.

• Global Collaboration: Proven success working effectively within globally distributed teams, displaying exceptional written and asynchronous communication skills across overlapping US/APAC working hours.

• Systems & Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect user insights directly to business metrics, product adoption, and technical feasibility.

• Growth Mindset & Empathy: Strong self-awareness, receptiveness to feedback, and passion for solving high-stakes identity and security problems.

Qualifications

• Experience: 4+ years of product development experience conducting UX research in enterprise/B2B product environments, OR a Master’s degree/PhD in HCI, Psychology, Anthropology, Sociology, or related field with 2+ years of experience.

• Portfolio: A digital portfolio or case study deck demonstrating end to end research ownership, complex technical problem spaces, generative and evaluative methodologies, and measurable business/product impact.

• Platform Knowledge: Experience researching desktop and mobile applications across macOS, Windows, iOS, or Android environments.

• Security Context: Background in identity, access management, cybersecurity, or enterprise IT admin tools is a strong plus.

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Product

Okta’s Auth0 is an easy-to-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier-Ø global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.

The Team

The Delegated Administration team is expanding Auth0 to help B2B SaaS applications easily manage access for their own customers and partners, at scale. We make it possible for enterprise SaaS users to log in with the right set of permissions within the right context, and for our B2B customers to onboard access for their customers easily. Our work is cross-cutting and always heavily customer driven.

We work in NodeJS (JavaScript and TypeScript) and use PostgreSQL for our data needs. Our services run on AWS and Azure and we lean heavily on containers for both our development and production needs.

If you have a keen eye for good user experiences and enjoy solving hard problems at scale we can’t wait to talk to you.

What you’ll be doing

• Help drive architectural vision and strategy on the team to design and deliver powerful new enterprise functionality for our SaaS customers - both for the login flow itself and for Auth0’s direct and self-service management capabilities

• Identify and implement strategic technical improvements to our codebase and architecture. Orchestrate and lead major technical projects, across teams as necessary.

• Mentor and coach less experienced engineers on sound engineering practices and technical leadership. Serve as a subject matter expert on all building scalable, reliable and maintainable distributed systems.

• Work with your team, the Product Manager and Product Designer to define the look, feel and functionality of new features and review customer feedback

What you’ll bring to the role

• You bring solid architectural and security knowledge, backed by experience in designing, implementing and evolving complex distributed systems.

• You have worked on projects that required close collaboration with external teams, and have experience making those a success.

• You are a good mentor and communicator, and bring the rest of your team along for the journey. You can explain complex concepts simply in person or in a document. You know that while an engineer can write code, teams collaborate to ship successful products.

• You have solid previous experience with Node.js (JavaScript or Typescript) to build scalable backend services and creating and maintaining public and internal APIs.

• You have built frontend and full-stack apps and know what approach to use when. You know how to build SPAs, have a good understanding of React and know your way around CSS.

• You have a good understanding of SQL databases and know how to debug and optimize table and query structure for performance under load.

• You have experience with Docker and cloud environments (AWS and Azure preferred).

• You have proven experience operating services at scale with appropriate observability tools and mechanisms.

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following !

• Knowledge of authentication protocols such as OAuth2, OIDC, SAML.

• Understanding and experience of DevOps culture. We have infrastructure teams that build interfaces for product teams but we love working with engineers who can reason about the workings under the covers - and roll their sleeves up to write some Terraform, if need be.

• Knowledge of security engineering and application security.

jobs.description:
Who are we?
Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!
Adoption of AI is moving rapidly from pilots to production. Enterprises and public sector organizations are investing in generative-AI programs, creating a once-in-a-decade market inflection point. At Cohere, we're committed to transforming the enterprise landscape through strategic partnerships and innovative AI solutions. As a Partner Development Manager for Germany and the DACH Region focused on the Public Sector & Enterprise Market, you'll be at the heart of our mission to empower businesses and government entities across the region with cutting-edge AI technologies.
This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic, cross-cultural environment and is passionate about driving growth through collaboration. You'll work closely with leading enterprises, system integrators, technology partners, and public sector organizations to co-create value, expand market reach, and deliver impactful AI solutions tailored to the unique needs of businesses and government agencies.
Your work will directly contribute to our success. You'll have the opportunity to shape partnerships that drive digital transformation in both commercial and public sectors, foster innovation, and position Cohere as a leader in the AI ecosystem.
If you're a strategic thinker, a relationship builder, and eager to make a meaningful impact in one of the world's most dynamic markets including the public sector, this role is your chance to shape the future of AI.

Key Responsibilities
Partner Strategy & Execution
• Define and execute Cohere's partner go-to-market plan for the Enterprise & Public Sector Market, aligning with regional business objectives.

• Partner with the broader GTM team to identify and recruit high-impact partners across system integrators, distributors, resellers, ISVs, cloud providers, and public sector consultancy firms.

• Develop relationships with key stakeholders across the partner ecosystem, including government agencies, municipalities, and public sector institutions, to ensure partnership success.

Partner Onboarding & Enablement
• Lead partner onboarding, certification, and training programs to ensure partners are equipped to sell, deploy and manage Cohere's solutions effectively for both commercial and public sector customers.

• Collaborate with enablement to scale partner enablement through sales and technical workshops, empowering them to deliver value to enterprise customers and government agencies.

Pipeline Generation & Co-Selling
• Own joint pipeline generation by creating co-sell motions, solution plays, and strategic joint go-to market motions that align Cohere's capabilities with enterprise mission needs and public sector procurement cycles.

• Collaborate with partners to identify and pursue high-value opportunities in both commercial and government contracts.

Business Planning & Performance Tracking
• Ensure partners are aligned with Cohere's strategic goals and performance metrics, including public sector compliance and reporting requirements.

• Run joint business planning sessions and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with partners, tracking sourced and influenced ARR against targets.

Partner Advocacy & Feedback
• Serve as the voice of the partner within Cohere, relaying feedback to Product, Engineering, and Legal teams.

• Work with Cohere's Public Policy teams to navigate government AI policies and regulations to advise partners on risk management and responsible AI best practices for the public sector.

Thought Leadership & Evangelism
• Evangelize Cohere's vision and solutions at partner and industry events, positioning Cohere as a leader in responsible GenAI for both commercial and public sector markets.

• Build thought leadership through briefings, speaking engagements, and collaborative initiatives focused on AI in government and public services.

Why You'll Love This Role
This is a high-impact role where you'll shape the future of AI partnerships in both commercial and public sectors. You'll work at the intersection of technology, business, and policy, driving growth while ensuring responsible AI adoption across enterprises and government organizations. If you're passionate about building strategic alliances, driving innovation, and making a difference in one of the world's most dynamic markets including the public sector, this is the role for you.

What We're Looking For
• 8+ years of experience in partner development, channel sales, or alliance management within the tech industry, preferably in AI or cloud solutions, with a track record of enterprise ARR contribution and public sector partnerships.

• Deep understanding of public sector organizations, government agencies, and municipal institutions, plus the enterprise market and key industry verticals.

• Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with a track record of driving partner success in both commercial and public sector environments.

• Experience and demonstrated depth with Sovereign Cloud GTM.

• Ability to navigate complex regulatory and compliance landscapes, including AI ethics, government policies, and public sector procurement requirements.

• Working understanding of AI (LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows) and their applications in enterprise and public sector contexts.

• Experience working with major system integrators, global consultancies, hyperscalers, and public sector technology partners including joint GTM and co-sell motions.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to evangelize Cohere's vision to partners, government stakeholders, and industry organizations.

• Results-driven growth mindset and bias for action. You thrive in a start-up-speed environment and enjoy building and scaling partner programs across commercial and public sectors.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a dynamic, cross-cultural environment and wants to make a meaningful impact on how AI transforms both businesses and public services. The Berlin location provides access to a vibrant tech ecosystem with strong connections to European public sector initiatives and government partnerships.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:
• A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

• Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

• RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

• 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

• Annual enrichment benefits:
Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

• 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

• Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:
• Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

• For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

• For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

• Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Reddit has a flexible workforce! If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like. Don't live near one of our offices? No worries: You can apply to work remotely in any country in which we have a physical presence

Reddit brings people together around their interests, questions, and experiences. Our communities create rich and complex data, and we build tools that help people turn that data into reliable understanding.

The Data Science Platform team develops Rosso, Reddit’s analytics agent, and the shared tools that support analytical and scientific work across the company. We are looking for software engineers who enjoy building AI systems that people can depend on: useful workflows, clear interfaces, thoughtful evals, and software that improves through production experience.

In this role, you will own a substantial part of our agent and scientific-tooling platform. You will design and ship capabilities, maintain and improve existing systems, and work with applied scientists and data scientists to make advanced analysis accessible. You will remain close to the code and to the people using it, from an initial prototype through rollout, operation, and ongoing refinement.

Responsibilities

• Build, maintain, and improve the software that powers our analytics agent and shared analytical workflows, including backend services, reusable libraries, APIs, and integrations with data and scientific tools.

• Design reliable agent workflows: context retrieval, planning and orchestration, structured tool calls, execution state, result validation, and clear handling of incomplete or failed tasks.

• Develop evaluation infrastructure and use it continuously. Maintain versioned task sets, automated checks, human-reviewed examples, regression reports, and release gates that expose meaningful failures.

• Improve agent quality through careful failure analysis and measured changes to prompts, context, tools, model selection, and workflow design, balancing correctness, latency, and cost.

• Operate production systems with actionable observability, incident response, dependency upgrades, backward-compatible interfaces, staged releases, and rollback paths.

• Build secure analytical execution and data integrations with appropriate access controls, execution limits, audit trails, provenance, and reproducible artifacts.

• Partner with scientists to turn validated methods into supported capabilities, preserving input requirements, diagnostics, uncertainty, and limitations through the API and agent experience.

• Lead technical design and delivery within your area, coordinate with partner teams, review code and designs, mentor engineers, and improve how the team builds and maintains software.

• Work directly with users to prioritize recurring needs, support adoption and migrations, and measure whether the platform helps people complete analytical work successfully.

Required qualifications

• Substantial professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production services, platforms, or developer tools from design through deployment and ongoing operation. Five or more years is a useful sourcing guideline.

• Strong programming ability, including production Python, and sound engineering fundamentals in API design, data modeling, automated testing, code review, distributed systems, and debugging.

• Hands-on experience building and deploying tool-using agents or multi-step LLM applications, with concrete understanding of context, structured outputs, orchestration, state, and model failure modes.

• Experience designing and using evals to improve AI systems: representative cases, baselines, failure analysis, grader limitations, and quality criteria that influence what ships.

• Practical experience with service reliability, authorization, queues or asynchronous execution, timeouts, retries, idempotency, and operational monitoring.

• Working fluency in SQL and experience integrating data-intensive services or analytical tools; an ability to preserve data provenance and documented analytical constraints.

• A record of leading substantial technical work with other engineers and partner teams, explaining tradeoffs clearly, and helping others contribute effectively.

• A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with analytics agents, text-to-SQL, data discovery, notebook or code-execution environments, or internal platforms for data scientists.

• Experience with agent evaluation harnesses, tool protocols such as MCP, model gateways, retrieval systems, or secure sandboxed execution.

• Experience building reusable scientific libraries, packaging statistical methods behind stable APIs, or collaborating closely with scientists on validation.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and large-scale analytical data systems such as BigQuery, Trino, Spark, or Airflow.

• Experience building product interfaces in TypeScript or React, or improving developer experience and adoption for a shared platform.

This is a hands-on software engineering role. We value the ability to learn the analytical domain and work well with scientific experts; a research degree, publication record, and novel-method research are not required.

Benefits:

• Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

• 401k with Employer Match

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

• Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ .
